en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2181 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"There is no man from a region who stands at Arafat among the believers without Allah (swt) forgiving the believers of that region. And there is no man from a household who stands at Arafat among the believers without Allah (swt) forgiving the believers of that household."
